steps.en: Diplomat/military notices are temporarily suspended under a set code and period
steps.id: Notice diplomat/militer ditangguhkan sementara dengan kode dan periode tertentu
steps.why_en: They are suspended permanently at the third reminder stage, with no period.
steps.why_id: Notice ditangguhkan permanen di tahap reminder ketiga, tanpa periode.

steps.en: The system reads a configurable minimum count of outstanding notices per entity
steps.id: OCMS membaca jumlah minimum notice outstanding per entity yang bisa diatur
steps.why_en: No setting or check for this minimum count exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengaturan atau pengecekan untuk jumlah minimum ini di sistem.

steps.en: The system counts outstanding notices of each entity across all its vehicles
steps.id: OCMS menghitung notice outstanding tiap entity di semua kendaraannya
steps.why_en: Only a one-ID search exists; nothing sweeps all entities and their vehicles.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pencarian satu ID; tidak ada proses yang menyisir semua entity dan kendaraannya.

steps.en: Notices are selected by preset conditions on suspension status, code and type
steps.id: Notice dipilih dengan kondisi preset: status, kode, dan jenis suspension
steps.why_en: Only a basic not-permanently-suspended check exists, no code-based selection.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada cek dasar bukan permanent suspension, tanpa seleksi berdasarkan kode.

steps.en: The system decides whether to generate reminder letters based on that count
steps.id: OCMS memutuskan membuat reminder letter berdasarkan jumlah tersebut
steps.why_en: Letters depend only on notice stage; no count-based decision exists.
steps.why_id: Letter hanya bergantung pada tahap notice; tidak ada keputusan berbasis jumlah.

steps.en: The reminder letters are routed to the officer's dashboard for follow-up
steps.id: Reminder letter diarahkan ke dashboard petugas untuk tindak lanjut
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty and the work item menu is switched off.
steps.why_id: Dashboard kosong dan menu work item dimatikan.
